propositions: A plan asserts that a named module or symbol provides a capability, but the code shows it does not (as in dc58: completion.py lacks signing capability; db7b: REVIEW_RESULT not in KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES for compaction)
A plan asserts that a capability must be built because it is absent, but the code already implements it (as in 5886: unmapped-Jira-status alert already emitted by fetcher.py)
The new advisory criterion asserted-capability is registered in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER with default_posture advisory and exec AGENT
The criterion is integrated into the four-pass finder/verifier/decide/coach machinery via criteria_routing.json and plan_review_asserted_capability.md rubric prompt

A bounded sanity check with 3 E1-verified misses and 3 clean controls achieves >=2/3 recall on misses and records any false fires as non-blocking advisory dogfood signals for future promotion-gate evaluation
The criterion auto-flows into the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder with zero per-criterion wiring and complies with all registration invariants and CI validation checks
